notes.title: Build 0.6.7.h2 Patch Notes
notes.content:
This update is live for both the game and demo versions.


Notable Improvements
- Changed how the decoration cap is calculated to be more dynamic, now scaling with the store size.

- Restock workers now prioritize shelves with the least items first.

- Added discounted packages for miniatures.

- Added a capacity display on the left to show a shelf's capacity.


Notable Bug Fixes
- Fixed the furniture 2 perk description being outdated.

- Fixed the price setting display not selecting the correct icon for miniatures.

- Fixed purchased tiles counter not being reset when going back to menu without quitting, resulting in increased store expansion prices.

- Fixed an issue with the broom not getting unfocused if picked up by worker while highlighted by the player.

- Fixed an issue causing storage workers to get stuck while leaving at the end of the day.



//

notes.title: Build 0.6.7.h1 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Notable improvements


Slightly adjusted the demand impact on customer buy chance so that lower demand items are being considered slightly more.

Added a demo build which is currently under review. Full announcement when it is available for download.


Notable Bug Fixes
Fixed an issue causing thieves to not despawn when reaching the edge of the map while running away with items.

Fixed an issue causing thieves to leave with stolen items without running away.

Market category for miniatures is now clickable.



//

notes.title: Build 0.6.7 Patch Notes
notes.content:
This is the last planned content update before the early access release, coming early October! 


Features

Miniatures!
As the last planned item for the initial early access release, miniatures are now available for purchase!

Like all the other items, they can be unlocked through the perk tree.



There are currently 3 sets available, each set containing 4 individual miniatures.

Finally, unlocking a miniature set perk also unlocks new decoration statues that match the miniature set.




Inventory App Overhaul
A new perk has been introduced that will allow the player to unlock the inventory app.

The inventory app has been made more useful through the following additions:

- All the items that are currently unlocked are displayed in the inventory app, regardless of them being in stock or not.

- In addition to being able to set the price, players can also order items directly from the inventory app.




Notable Improvements
- Added a new "Shelf Settings" panel. 

    Currently, the only setting is the ability to block restocking on a shelf. 

    In the future, this panel will be expanded to include more settings.

- Adjusted the leveling curve to be slightly more lenient, especially in the early game.

- Adjusted customer spawn ratios to be slightly higher, mostly impacting the early game.

- Adjusted the checkout speed review type to be slightly less lenient.

- Doubled npc name lists as well as the passerby action lists. (No more "Walking the dog" action, I'm afraid)

- Added credits to main menu and discord link button in the patch notes panel.




Notable Bug Fixes
- Fixed some issues causing items not being placed correctly in build mode.

- Fixed an issue where the inventory app would not update when items were added or removed.

- Fixed an issue causing music volume to change unexpectedly when playing a new music track.

Plus many other small fixes!



//

notes.title: Build 0.6.5.h1 Patch Notes
notes.content:
This is a build to address some of the more prominent issues found in the latest beta test!


Notable Improvements


- Added neutral reviews. This makes it so if values are only slightly negative/positive, customers will instead leave a neutral review.

- Slightly boosted plant decoration value.

- Made variety reviews a little more lenient for early game.

- Made litter chance code more reliable.

- Added a 20s cooldown for customer litter chance (Chance roll every 20s).

- The checkout can now be moved even if there are customers in the queue.

- The player can now take over a checkout from cashier workers, causing them to go idle.

- Added sound fx for right-clicking on npcs.

- Added a "max buy attempts" value to customers. This is to reduce the store's overcrowding.


Notable Bug Fixes
- Fixed a value mismatch for decor score of clearing trash piles.

- Fixed an issue that prevented workers cleaning not counting towards the decor score.(Trash piles would add permanent impact)

- Fixed in-game guide not scaling well in ultra-wide resolutions.

- Fixed the customer info panel overlapping when in build mode.

- Fixed an issue preventing wall and floors from being saved correctly.

- Fixed transparent walls not being set back to customized material.

- Fixed an issue that would reset the wall/floor materials even if purchased.

- Fixed an issue with some walls not turning transparent when the player is behind them.

- Fixed an issue preventing staff live actions from being displayed in the info panel.

- Greatly improved staff spawning mechanics, making them less prone to issues.

- Fixed an issue causing the workers to not drop the broom when fired.

- Fixed an issue causing the workers to leave with the broom in hand when the day ended.

- Fixed an issue that would keep a box highlighted by the player when picked up by the staff.

- Fixed an issue that would make stolen items be ignored by the Inventory manager, resulting in negative values.

- Temporarily removed outline to selected npcs. (This will be re-enabled in a future patch)

- Fixed an issue with control popup bindings not updating after rebinding a key.

- Fixed an issue preventing the player's highlighted object not resetting when going back to menu.



//

notes.title: Build 0.6.5 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Features

Global Market
There is a new app in the phone interface called "Global Market".



- With this app, players can now visualize the demand for every item in the game.

- Customers are a lot more likely to buy items that are in high demand.

- The demand varies every in-game day, so make sure to check back before planning your restocks.




In-Game Guide
You can now access a series of in-game guides from the settings or from buttons marked with a question mark.



The new guides include mechanics that are not covered in the initial tutorial, such as:

- Staff Management

- Store Rating

- Global Market

- Cleaning the Store

- Thieves




Notable Improvements
Add pulse animation to the build button counter when new furniture is deposited on the pallet.

Updated cursor graphic.

Reduced staff speed perk increment from 0.5 to 0.4. (They were zooming a little too much.)

Added checkout "reservation" to avoid multiple cashiers going to the same checkout.

Added "Item Stands" to shelves to display the item assigned.

Added salary info to the Staff app in the phone.

Added hover and scale animations to the cashier interface.

Added more info to the cart items list as well as buttons to remove/add 1 item at a time.

Added the option to order empty boxes.

Overhauled player customization interface and added more options.

Staff now wear similar clothing.

Every npc can now be right-clicked to view their information.


Notable Bug Fixes
Fixed an issue that prevented player movement after going back to menu.

Fixed the body type 2 prefab not turning walls transparent when behind them.

Added missing control popups for the broom.

Fixed a bug that would make it so changing the wall color would also change the pallet.

Fixed an issue that would make the player be able to call two trucks with the same load.

Fixed an issue that would bypass the player set sound settings for the thief chase music.

Fixed an issue that would make customers skip the queue and immediately upload items to the checkout.

Fixed an issue that would prevent re-hiring staff if fired on the same day.

Fixed an issue that would allow customers to purchase more items than the allowed maximum.

Added several checks and fail safes to prevent customers from leaving with items when the store is closed. (99% patched, still some edge cases.)

Fixed some texture flickering where road tiles connect.

Fixed an issue that would prevent the initial shelf from being able to be sold.

Prevented being able to enter build mode while main UI panels are open.

Fixed an issue that would keep a shelf as interactable if it was moved while the player was in focus range.

Made broom control popups appearance more accurate.

Resized player interaction collider to be more accurate (maybe, tbh).

Fixed an issue that prevented utilities and salaries expenses from bringing the balance below 0.

Fixed an issue that would break the game on game over.

And many, many more small fixes!



//

notes.title: Build 0.6.3 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Features

Store Rating Overhaul
The store rating is now managed by an overall rating and three sub-ratings. The overall rating is the average of the three sub-ratings.

The sub-ratings each control a specific category:

Variety. Based on the store's item variety.

Efficiency. Based on the store's staff efficiency.

Decoration. Based on the store's decoration/cleanliness.

In addition, you can now right-click on a customer to view what they are doing and their thoughts on the store. Finally, all review conditions have been re-balanced, but may need further tuning.




Walls and Floor Customization
You can now access new customization options from your store app in the phone.

The new customization options include:

10 wall colors.

3 floor textures.

This feature is experimental and subject to change. More customization options will be added in future updates.


Italian Localization Update
100% of the game has been translated to Italian.




Notable Improvements
Changed percentage buttons in price setting to 15% and 30%.

Cashier workers now only leave when the queue is empty.

Added an indicator to the cashier interface that shows the remaining queue.

Added a notification counter to the build mode button that shows the amount of furniture in your inventory.

Added a small animation to category buttons in the phone to better show the selected category.

Collision system overhaul. Collisions are now a lot more accurate when placing or moving furniture.

Added a small pop animation to furniture when placed.

Customers will now not consider shelves in the warehouse area of the store.

The amount of money a customer pays for play tables is now correctly deducted from their money to spend.




Notable Bug Fixes
Fixed the tutorial localization not updating at runtime.

Fixed the furniture inventory not resizing to scroll horizontally when a lot of furniture is displayed.

Fixed various text objects no resizing correctly.

Fixed an issue that prevented rmb mouse input after going back to menu.

Fixed a few issues that caused customers to get stuck in checkout queues.

Fixed an issue that caused boxes to get stuck when the player and worker deposited at the same time.

Fixed arcades not counting as decorations.

Fixed some issues that prevented the decoration counter from updating correctly.

Fixed ceilings not being properly activated/deactivated when loading a save file.

Fixed trash piles not being deleted when switching to another save file.
